id_no.description: Internal Kaggle numeric ID (optional, assigned by Kaggle).

title.description: Display title of the kernel on Kaggle.

code_file.description: Relative path to the notebook (.ipynb) or script (.py, .r, .Rmd) file.

is_private.description: Whether the kernel is private to you and your collaborators.

enable_internet.description: Enable outbound internet access during kernel execution.

dataset_sources.description: List of dataset slugs mounted as input data (format: 'username/dataset-slug').

competition_sources.description: List of competition names whose data is mounted to the kernel.

kernel_sources.description: List of upstream kernel slugs used as inputs.

model_sources.description: List of model slugs mounted to the kernel (e.g., 'keras/bert/keras/default').

keywords.description: List of tag strings for discovery.
